channel.title: FXStreet Forex & Commodities News
channel.description: Real-time Forex News and the latest trading updates. Stay updated on the latest news about currencies and commodities markets.

item.title: United States Dollar Index rises to near 100.00 ahead of US inflation data
item.description: The US Dollar Index (DXY), which measures the value of the US Dollar (USD) against six major currencies, is extending gains for the third successive day and trading around 99.90 during the Asian hours on Wednesday.

item.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD rises to near $65.40 with US inflation in focus
item.description: Silver price (XAG/USD) trades 1.1% higher at around $65.40 during the Asian trading session on Wednesday. The white metal reflects strength ahead of the United States (US) Consumer Price Index (CPI) data for July, which will be published at 12:30 GMT.

item.title: Canadian Dollar eases from two-month high as USD preserves weekly gains ahead of US CPI
item.description: The USD/CAD pair ticks higher during the Asian session on Wednesday, snapping a three-day losing streak to the 1.3915 area or its lowest level since June 10. Spot prices, however, lack bullish conviction and trade around 1.3930, awaiting the release of the latest US inflation figures.

item.title: New Zealand Dollar struggles as US Dollar gains on Middle East uncertainty
item.description: NZD/USD continues its losing streak for the third consecutive day, trading around 0.5870 during the Asian hours on Wednesday. The pair depreciates as the US Dollar (USD) gains ground on increased safe-haven demand amid rising uncertainty surrounding Middle East peace talks.

item.title: Australian Dollar slips as US Dollar strengthens amid uncertainty over Fed outlook
item.description: AUD/USD depreciates after registering modest gains in the previous day, trading around 0.7060 during the Asian hours on Wednesday. The currency pair loses ground as the US Dollar (USD) rises ahead of a crucial inflation report.

item.title: Japanese Yen slides to two-week low, seems vulnerable as USD stands firm ahead of US CPI
item.description: The USD/JPY pair touches a one-and-a-half-week high during the Asian session on Wednesday, with bulls now looking to build on the momentum further beyond mid-159.00s amid a supportive fundamental backdrop.

item.title: British Pound loses as rising US Dollar, geopolitical tensions weigh on sentiment
item.description: GBP/USD inches lower after remaining flat in the previous day, trading around 1.3500 during the Asian hours on Wednesday. The currency pair continues to hold its losses as the US Dollar (USD) gains strength ahead of a crucial inflation report.

item.title: Gold trades with positive bias below $4,400; Fed hike bets cap gains ahead of US CPI
item.description: Gold (XAU/USD) attracts some dip-buyers during the Asian session on Wednesday, stalling the previous day's retracement slide from the $4,435 region, or the highest level since June 5.

item.title: Experts split on whether next RBA move is a hike or cut amid energy risks
item.description: The Reserve Bank of Australia (RBA) unanimously held rates at 4.35% in August, but major economic forecasters offer varying takes on what comes next:

item.title: PBOC sets USD/CNY reference rate at 6.7882 vs. 6.7900 previous
item.description: On Wednesday, the People’s Bank of China (PBOC) sets the USD/CNY central rate for the trading session ahead at 6.7882 compared to the previous day's fix of 6.7900 and 6.7430 Reuters estimate.

item.title: Euro consolidates below mid-1.1500s vs USD ahead of German HICP, US CPI
item.description: The EUR/USD pair struggles to gain any meaningful traction and holds steady around mid-1.1500s during the Asian session on Wednesday, within a familiar range held over the past week or so.

item.title: WTI advances above $82.50 due to mixed signals regarding potential US-Iran deal
item.description: West Texas Intermediate (WTI) oil price extends its gains for the third successive day, trading around $82.70 per barrel during the Asian hours on Wednesday. Crude oil prices advance as investors weigh mixed signals regarding a potential deal between the United States (US) and Iran.

item.title: GBP/JPY Price Forecast: Struggles at 50-day SMA with bulls near 215.50
item.description: The GBP/JPY ended Tuesday’s session unchanged at 215.17 as buyers remained reluctant to test the 50-day Simple Moving Average (SMA) at 215.43, seen as the first resistance level on its way to re-test yearly peaked at around 219.61.

item.title: Singapore Dollar: Decline risks assessed against US Dollar – OCBC
item.description: OCBC analysts Sim Moh Siong and Christopher Wong discuss USD/SGD after its post-payroll decline, noting the pair last traded near 1.28 with bearish momentum starting to wane.

item.title: The Australian Dollar goes seven weeks without a central bank
item.description: AUD/USD trades just above 0.7050 on Tuesday August 11, a tenth of a percent firmer inside a 29-pip range, having taken the Reserve Bank of Australia (RBA) decision entirely in its stride.

item.title: US yields ease as CPI caution offsets Oil rally
item.description: US Treasury yields eased on Tuesday as most investors remain cautious, awaiting the release of US inflation figures and the resolution of the US-Iran conflict, which has encountered hurdles.

item.title: Chinese Yuan: Range trade persists, upside risk against US Dollar – UOB
item.description: United Overseas Bank (UOB) analysts Quek Ser Leang and Lee Sue Ann expect USD/CNH to remain confined in a narrow intraday range, reflecting flat momentum indicators. Over the next 1–3 weeks, they still see scope for the Dollar to edge lower toward 6.7300 while resistance has shifted higher.

item.title: The Japanese Yen gives back half of a record intervention
item.description: USD/JPY trades just beneath 159.50 on Tuesday August 11, effectively unchanged inside a 47-pip range, wedged between a reclaimed 200-day moving average near 158.00 and a declining 50-day near 160.50.

item.title: Indonesian Rupiah: BI succession supports IDR against US Dollar – OCBC
item.description: OCBC’s Sim Moh Siong and Christopher Wong note that Indonesian Rupiah (IDR) strengthened to near a two‑month high on a softer US Dollar (USD) after weak United States (US) payrolls and clarity over Bank Indonesia (BI) leadership, with Destry Damayanti nominated as sole governor candidate.

item.title: Mexican Peso hits 25-month high as US CPI lurks
item.description: The Mexican Peso (MXN) is poised to end Tuesday’s session with solid gains of 0.32% against the US Dollar (USD) as money markets await the release of the US July inflation figures, while USD/MXN trades at 17.08, a level last seen in June 2024.

item.title: Singapore: AI-driven growth supports MAS outlook – Standard Chartered
item.description: Standard Chartered Bank economists Edward Lee and Jonathan Koh highlight that Singapore’s H1 GDP expanded 6.1% year-on-year, with strong AI-related demand offsetting energy sector drag.

item.title: British Pound Sterling needs a fourth dissenter
item.description: GBP/USD trades near 1.3500 on Tuesday August 11, a shade lower on the session and inside a range of barely 25 pips, with nothing British on the calendar to account for either the level or the calm.

item.title: Thai Baht: Benign inflation keeps BoT on hold – Commerzbank
item.description: Commerzbank strategists note July Consumer Price Index (CPI) eased to 2.0% year-on-year, below consensus, mainly due to softer retail fuel prices. While core CPI has been gradually rising, overall price pressures are described as manageable and below government forecasts.

item.title: Euro stalls below 100-day SMA as investors brace for US CPI
item.description: The Euro (EUR) registers minimal losses against the US Dollar (USD) on Tuesday as traders and market participants prepare for the release of the US Consumer Price Index (CPI) on Wednesday, which could set the path for the future of US monetary policy.

item.title: Chinese Yuan: Measured appreciation with strong RMB – OCBC
item.description: OCBC’s Sim Moh Siong and Christopher Wong note USD/CNH slipped after weak US payrolls, with the Renminbi (RMB) near its strongest levels in over three years.

item.title: Singapore Dollar: Range bias with upside risk against US Dollar – UOB
item.description: United Overseas Bank’s (UOB) Quek Ser Leang and Lee Sue Ann expect USD/SGD to remain in a tight intraday band after Monday’s modest rebound, with the pair seen between 1.2785 and 1.2815.

item.title: Australian Dollar: Policy risks balanced as inflation lingers – Standard Chartered
item.description: Standard Chartered’s Nicholas Chia reports that the Reserve Bank of Australia (RBA) kept the cash rate at 4.35% in a unanimous decision, as widely expected. Chia notes the RBA sees inflation returning to the midpoint of its 2–3% target only by late 2027.

item.title: British Pound: Sterling recovery eyes 1.36 caps against US Dollar – Scotiabank
item.description: Scotiabank strategists Shaun Osborne and Eric Theoret observe that the British Pound (GBP) is consolidating gains near the top of its one-month and multi-month ranges, with price action closely tied to fading downside risk reversals.

item.title: Forex Today: US Dollar on pause ahead of US CPI
item.description: The US Dollar Index (DXY) is trading little changed in the vicinity below the 100.00 price zone ahead of the United States (US) July Consumer Price Index (CPI), which is expected on Wednesday.

item.title: Oil: Strait of Hormuz risk premium – Commerzbank
item.description: Commerzbank’s energy team notes fading hopes for a US–Iran agreement to reopen the Strait of Hormuz, driving Brent toward USD 90 and gas oil to nearly USD 1,350 per ton. Drone attacks on refineries in Saudi Arabia, Russia, Libya and tight diesel supply add to the risk premium.
